name: wc2026-fixtures-bundle
description: Static fallback for the wc-prediction-strategy Agent Skill. Mirrors the JSON shape returned by INJAFRICA's Africp `get_upcoming_matches` and `get_leaderboard` tools so a reasoning agent without a live endpoint can still produce non-empty outputs.
loaderHint: If /api/africp is unreachable or the caller's session is unauthenticated, the agent should fetch /wc2026-fixtures.json and /wc2026-leaderboard-snapshot.json in place of the corresponding tool calls. The fixtures file declares syntheticData: false (it carries the real WC2026 group-stage schedule); the leaderboard file declares syntheticData: true — surface the synthetic nature of the leaderboard to the user and recommend a live install for real player data.
notBundled: wc2026-getScoringRules.json — the scoring rules are static text already embedded in SKILL.md
wc2026-getUserPoints.json — the user_points tool reads from the caller's authenticated session and cannot be meaningfully faked offline
wc2026-submitPrediction.json — write tool; offline agents must NEVER attempt to fabricate agent drafts
